title: Unprepared spins require one electron per isolated rail
statement: On square sites with rails(1,2),(3,4),one electron per rail gives four charge states |13>,|24>,|14>,|23>; code |13>,|24>. Arbitrary unprepared rail spins are permitted only under H=Hcharge tensor I+I tensor Hspin and position-independent source-spin action. The six-charge N=2 polarized sector is different. Quarter-X exact return uses t=sqrt(3)Delta/4,T=pi hbar/Delta,Delta=(K/a)(1/sqrt(2)-1/2),yielding scalar exp(i pi X/4); quadrupole gives continuous Z. Symmetric four-edge fermionic hopping instead destructively interferes. Wrong-rail charge,doublons,spin-orbit,position-dependent fields and interrail exchange are excluded.
